g.text: investment-analyst-toolkit — terminal dashboard
Research and education only — not investment advice, never a buy/sell/hold recommendation.
Symbol: DEMO Bars: 80 Range: 2026-07-20 to 2026-11-06 Last close: 1284.91
Exchange (assumed): NEPSE — the demo does not detect the market from the CSV; the risk gate below uses the NEPSE default config.
1. Indicator snapshot
Indicators describe the past; they cannot prove what a price will do next.
Close 1284.91 — trend vs SMA20/EMA20: above SMA20 and above EMA20
RSI(14) 88.2 (70/30 are conventions, not reversal proofs)
MACD 12/26/9 53.32 signal 41.82 histogram 11.50
Bollinger 20/2 upper 1312.50 middle 1166.08 lower 1019.66 %B 0.91
ATR(14) 16.79 (how much prices moved, not which way next)
VWAP (cumulative) 1046.60
2. Screening — named setups (scanner rules, reimplemented here)
A match means the past closes satisfy the stated rule. It is not a buy/sell/hold signal.
[MATCH] breakout_20d: close 1284.91 above 20-day high 1274.72 (+0.80%)
rule: Latest close above the highest close of the prior 20 closes (needs 21 closes).
[MATCH] bull_flag: run +12.07% (1101.74 -> 1234.73), last-5 range 3.24%
rule: Close rose at least 10% over the 10 sessions ending 6 bars ago, then the last 5 closes span at most 5% (needs 16 closes).
[ -- ] reclaim_ma20: close already above MA20 on the prior bar (1274.72 vs 1156.63)
rule: Latest close above its 20-day moving average while the prior close was at or below its 20-day moving average (needs 21 closes).
[ -- ] oversold: RSI-14 88.2 (not below 30)
rule: Wilder RSI-14 below 30 on the latest close (needs 15 closes).
[ -- ] oversold_bounce: RSI-14 not below 30 in the last 5 sessions
rule: Wilder RSI-14 below 30 at least once in the last 5 sessions and the latest close above the prior close (needs 15 closes).
Matches: 2 of 5 setups. A match is a description of past closes, not a prediction.
3. Time-Machine odds
Simulation, not a prediction. Resampled history is not the future; a target-first share above break-even is a property of the past sample, not a probability of profit.
Hypothetical plan: entry 1284.91, stop 1259.72, target 1335.29 (stop = entry - 1.5 x ATR(14); reward:risk 2.00)
Seed 19, 10000 replays, horizon 20 days, 61 past windows
Target first 57.5% Stop first 39.0% Neither 3.5%
Break-even 33.3% Verdict: Strongly toward target
Final close: median 1334.07, p5 1244.46, p95 1359.89, average realised R 0.79
Historical replay (same rule, no randomness): target first 68.9%, stop first 31.1%, neither 0.0% over 61 past windows
4. Risk gate — hypothetical plan only
